description: The Konark Sun Temple is a 13th-century CE Sun temple at Konark in Odisha, designed as a colossal chariot with 24 wheels pulled by seven horses.
history: Built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty around 1250 CE. Designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.

description: Partially artificial and natural caves of archaeological, historical, and religious importance near Bhubaneswar.
history: Carved out during the 2nd century BCE as residential blocks for Jain monks under King Kharavela.

description: A Buddhist stupa monument overlooking the Daya River, where the Kalinga War is believed to have been fought.
history: Built in 1972 by the Japan Buddha Sangha and the Kalinga Nippon Buddha Sangha.

description: A hilltop major Buddhist monastic complex containing numerous shrines, sculptures, and a large stupa.
history: Dates back to the 5th to 13th century CE, serving as a prominent center of Buddhist learning in ancient India.

description: A famous Hindu temple dedicated to Jagannath, a form of Vishnu, located in Puri.
history: Originally built by King Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva in the 12th century. One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites.

description: One of the oldest temples in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to Lord Shiva, showcasing Kalinga architecture.
history: Built by the Somavamshi king Jajati I in the 11th century.

description: A 10th-century Hindu temple known as the 'gem of Odisha architecture' dedicated to Lord Shiva.
history: Built around 950-975 CE during the Somavamshi dynasty, famous for its exquisite torana (archway).

description: A large wildlife sanctuary and national park featuring dense forests, waterfalls, and diverse wildlife including tigers and elephants.
history: Established as a tiger reserve in 1956 and designated a national park in 1980; part of the UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves.

description: A national park in Odisha known for its rich mangrove ecosystem, saltwater crocodiles, and migratory birds.
history: Declared a national park in 1998, renowned for conservation efforts of the saltwater crocodile.

description: A tiger reserve situated along the Mahanadi River, featuring deep gorges, rugged terrain, and rich biodiversity.
history: Declared a sanctuary in 1976 and later designated as a tiger reserve.

description: A premier zoo and botanical garden near Bhubaneswar, famous for housing India's first captive white tigers.
history: Established in 1960 and opened to the public in 1968; set around the Chandaka forest and Kanjia lake.

description: Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, famous for winter migratory birds and Irrawaddy dolphins.
history: A Ramsar site supporting a rich ecosystem and livelihood for local fishing communities.

ticketPrices.boatRide: INR 1000 - 2500 per boat depending on distance

description: A hill station known as the 'Kashmir of Odisha', famous for pine forests, waterfalls, and cold climate.
history: Developed as a hill station getaway during the colonial period and post-independence.

description: The highest peak in Odisha, located in the Koraput district, offering panoramic views of the Eastern Ghats.
history: A popular trekking and nature tourism destination.

description: A stunning two-tiered waterfall located within the Similipal National Park region.
history: One of the highest waterfalls in India, plunging from a height of nearly 399 meters.

ticketPrices.entryFee: Included with Similipal National Park entry

description: A guided boat safari experience at Satapada in Chilika Lake to spot endangered Irrawaddy dolphins.
history: A major eco-tourism initiative managed jointly by the local community and Odisha Tourism.

description: An annual natural phenomenon where hundreds of thousands of Olive Ridley sea turtles arrive to nest.
history: Gahirmatha beach is recognized as the world's largest rookery for these endangered sea turtles.

ticketPrices.access: Requires prior permission from forest department

description: The grand annual chariot festival in Puri where deities Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra are pulled in massive wooden chariots.
history: Centuries-old annual Hindu tradition celebrated on Ashadha Shukla Paksha Dwitiya.

ticketPrices.viewing: Free (Paid rooftop view stands available privately)

description: A heritage village near Puri famous for traditional Pattachitra paintings and master palm-leaf engravers and weavers.
history: Declared a model heritage village, where nearly every family is involved in traditional crafts.

description: A 9th-century Hindu temple in Bhubaneswar known for its unique erotic carvings and pink sandstone architecture.
history: Built during the Somavamshi dynasty, often called the 'Love Temple' due to its romantic sculptures.
